title: Non-anchor position period prediction v38
rationale: This lane predeclares an absolute-position period target before any new evidence is scored. It is not another public-anchor mining pass because discovery does not use public known-plaintext anchors, additive fragment values, candidate key material, routed-key results, held-out anchor controls, source-expanded candidate screens, or prior public-fragment structure screens.
prediction_target: Future independently documented non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched in one or more predeclared one-based absolute-position residue classes from the registered period family at a rate exceeding seeded null, best-of-period, and multiple-comparison controls.
discovery_inputs: Predeclared structural period family over absolute one-based K4 positions
K4 ciphertext length and already-known clue positions only to mark the non-anchor complement for future targets
Residue classes emitted before observing or scoring any new source-backed position evidence
evaluation_inputs: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations
Source-reviewed observation files with source IDs, one-based positions, per-position notes, and rationale declared before evaluation
Position-only scoring target that excludes public anchor additive fragments as primary evidence
controls: seeded same-size non-anchor position shuffle baseline
best-of-period null control across the registered period family
multiple-comparison correction across declared residue classes
require-unique-artifact gate for any lane intended to add a new prediction target
promotion blocked unless future independent observations beat all predeclared controls without post-hoc retuning
